from pathlib import Path
p = Path("tests/test_db.py")
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace("from datetime import date, datetime\n", "import dataclasses\nimport shutil\nimport sqlite3\nfrom datetime import date, datetime\n", 1)

 "from ledgerline.models import Customer, Invoice, InvoiceLine, InvoiceStatus, StockItem\n", 1)
s += '''

def _table_columns(path: Path, table: str) -> set[str]:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})").fetchall()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return {row[1] for row in rows}


def _field_names(model: type) -> set[str]:
    return {f.name for f in dataclasses.fields(model)}


def test_schema_columns_match_models(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "ledger.db"
    Database(path).migrate()
    assert _table_columns(path, "invoices") == _field_names(Invoice) - {"lines"}
    assert _table_columns(path, "customers") == _field_names(Customer)
    assert _table_columns(path, "stock_items") == _field_names(StockItem)


def test_due_date_rename_keeps_existing_values(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    migrations = tmp_path / "migrations"
    migrations.mkdir()
    for name in ("0001_init.sql", "0002_add_customers.sql", "0003_invoice_due_date.sql"):
        shutil.copy(DEFAULT_MIGRATIONS_DIR / name, migrations / name)
    path = tmp_path / "ledger.db"
    old = Database(path, migrations_dir=migrations)
    old.migrate()
    old.close()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO invoices (number, currency, status, issued_at, due_date)"
        " VALUES ('INV-2026-00009', 'EUR', 'sent', '2026-03-04', '2026-04-03')"
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    assert Database(path).migrate() == ["0004_rename_due_date_to_due_on"]
    database = Database(path)
    loaded = database.list_invoices()
    database.close()
    assert [inv.due_on for inv in loaded] == [date(2026, 4, 3)]
    assert "due_date" not in _table_columns(path, "invoices")
'''
p.write_text(s)
